statement: Type incidence claims by what they certify: MARKED_POINTED_DOMINATION (a specified witness point lifts each tangent/base deformation) versus CLASS_CONSTRAINED_UNMARKED_DOMINATION (some coefficient-safe witness realizing the same transported class exists). Image equality/dimension is not evidence for the marked type without a pointwise differential/smoothness argument.
reuse_scope: Research routing/representation only; no theorem authority and no generic ResearchTool promotion.
framework_improvement_hypothesis: Add an incidence-typing guard to mathematical_context_translation/contextual_theory_gluing so projected-Hilbert or image-locus results cannot satisfy a fixed-witness lifting edge unless POINTED_DOMINATION evidence is present; allow a separate UNMARKED_CLASS_EXISTENCE edge when exact class/coefficient constraints are verified.
